picks.why: MIT CSAIL shows a frontier LLM natively reading and rewriting neural weights - a 0.016% edit to Qwen3.5-0.8B lifts MATH-500 from 7.9% to 48.1% and triples IFEval. If it holds, optimization becomes a language task.

An AI pentest agent found the two-month window where a backtick email address led to root on GNU Savannah and push access to Bash as its maintainer - the xz scenario demonstrated, responsibly, in days.
Anthropic's amended S-1: $33.24B nine-month revenue, Q3 growth slowing to 47%, and $895.4B in compute commitments - the first full balance-sheet look public investors get before the mega IPO.

Junior developer employment is down ~20% from 2022 and Anthropic's junior share fell from 27% to 9%; Voss lays out the most concrete proposal yet for interviewing engineers in the post-programming job.

An agent picked the drug, derived coordinates from three papers and drove a stereotaxic rig through mouse brain surgery - with a veterinarian holding a kill switch. The human-in-the-loop design is the story.
